value.title: Phase 2: Wi-Fi and read-only BluOS status
value.summary: Provisioning, read-only amp status, idle screen with faults and dimming.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Work top to bottom. Hardware smoke steps that take the knob from the Mac or touch the amp wait for Vaughan's go-ahead.

value.title: RED→GREEN: knob_core config validation (SSID/password non-empty, host set, port 1–65535, max_db ≤ −24, source_safe_db ≤ −24, step 0<step≤3)
value.success: Native tests with Test Doc blocks pass; unsafe values rejected
value.receipt: test_config 5/5 (RED 4 failed on stub first): SSID/host/port, max_db/source_safe_db <= -24, 0<step<=3, set-one-key atomicity, only wifi_pass secret

value.title: NVS config store + serial console (`set`, `show` with masked password, `reboot`); console never echoes secrets
value.receipt: show prints wifi_pass as **** (empty when unset); set refuses unsafe/unknown keys without writing; NVS store in config_store.cpp

value.title: scripts/fw_wifi.py + `just fw-wifi`: prompt SSID, getpass password, send to the device over serial, confirm connect result
value.success: Vaughan runs it and the device joins Wi-Fi; nothing secret in terminal history, logs or git

value.title: RED: capture real /Volume and /Status XML via the existing read-only harness into tests/fixtures/bluos/; native parser tests
value.success: Fixture-backed tests fail before parser exists
value.receipt: tests/fixtures/bluos/{volume,status}.xml captured read-only from 192.168.1.67; test_bluos_xml RED (3 failed) on stub

value.title: GREEN: BluOS XML field extraction + read-only HTTP adapter polling with backoff (no retry storms)
value.success: Parser tests green; adapter backs off when amp unreachable
value.receipt: test_bluos_xml 4/4 + test_timing backoff; bluos_client.cpp polls /Volume+/Status in its own task with Backoff(2s..30s); fail-closed on unreadable db

value.title: Screen v2: idle dB + source + Wi-Fi/knob icons, plain-language faults, dim after inactivity / wake on event (dim timer in core, fake-clock tested)
value.success: All states render; dim/wake tested natively

value.title: Hardware smoke: provision Wi-Fi, live volume/source shown; wrong host shows fault; dim + wake observed; 5 knob power-cycles and 3 Wi-Fi AP drops with gesture counts and min free heap logged
value.success: Recorded in execution log; no resets, no progressive heap loss

tk-2201.assertion: just fw-test green with rejection cases

tk-2203.assertion: grep of repo + serial capture finds no password

tk-2205.assertion: Backoff logic covered by a fake-clock test

tk-2207.assertion: Dim then wake on knob turn
All gestures counted after each reconnect; no reset; min free heap stable
